spans.text: Kom i exlál abal tam jún yab in exlál jawa' xi pél in uchbíl ani an k'e'atnaxtaláb in t'ajámal ka wa'tsin yani kidháb t'anél ani yan jita' axi odhnámej, ani kom uluwamej abal i ayál juni ít tsalap junti ka wa'tsin juni k'ay'lál juntij an k'wajílchik yabáts ka xe'tsin k'al i jík'ib mani ka k'wajiy al an ts'ejwantaltaiáb ani ka k'wajiy walkadh abal kin uluw ani kin bela'jawa'its jún kin le'na'.
Kom i exlál abal an éyalchik in tomnál kin beletna' ani kin k'aniy an chubaxtaiáb abal an inikchik yab kin yéjenchij kin dhay'k'a'an k'ak'adh pextaláb abal ka ats'anchat in káwintal.

Kom i exlál abal an bichówlom ti al an "Naciones Unidas" in wichk'ómalchik kin uluw abal in kwa'al in alwa' ichích abal kin k'ak'nanchij in éy ani in jalbíl tin putát an inik ani an uxum, ani in ulúmalchik abal ne'etschik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ka nixk'in an ts'ejwantaláb ti al juni walkadhtalá axi lej púlik tin tomnál ki ejtiy.

Kom i exlál abal an kwenchaláb axi k'wajat junkudh in binámal in káwintal abal neéts kin tolmiy an ONU abal kin k'ak'nanchij jawa' in kwa'al tin uchbíl kin bats'uwchik patal an k'wajíl tejé' al an tsabál, ani
kom i exlál abal axe'chik xi uchbidhtaláb in kwa'al lej yan in jalbíl bala ka putuwat jawa' xi tejé' k'wajat uludh:

entries.task_id: an jolataláb|abal|kin ejtow ka xe'tsin alwa'
entries.description: an jolataláb abal kin ejtow ka xe'tsin alwa'
entries.subject: an jolataláb
entries.object: kin ejtow ka xe'tsin alwa'

spans.text: Patal an k'wajíl in tomnál ka k'ak'nanchat in ejatal, in iniktal, in éy ani an jolataláb abal kin ejtow ka xe'tsin alwa'.

Tam kin bajuwits in tamúb, an uxum ani an inikchik, k'wajat jolat abal ka tomkin ani kin inkiychik juni k'imádh, ka k'wajiychik ti k'imadh ani max kin bajuwchik ka jíláxin, in tomnálchik ka k'ák'náchik ani ka pidhan jununúl in uchbíl.

Patal k'wajat jolat abal kin kwetém ko'oy in tsalápil ani in belkaxtal, ani abal kin t'aja' ani kin tejwamédha'tin k'imá'ani ju'támits kin le'na', nixé' xi belkaxtaláb, tin kwetémtal ani ti mudhél; jayetsej abal kin jalk'uy in belkaxtal tam kin le'na'.

Patal jolat abal kin tejwamédha' in tsalap ani in káwintal; axé' xi uchbidhtaláb jayetsej in ulal abal yab in tomnál ka k'e'atnáj tin ébál in tsalápil; jayetsej abal kin aliy ani kin bats'uw píl i tsalap ani abal kin buk'uw ma ju'támakits kin le'na' ani k'ai jawákits tam eyixtaláb.
Patal jolat abal ka ts'at'ey k'al jawákits tam junkudhtaláb abal ka dhéy t'ójon ani kin k'ániychik tin bá'.

folded.id: i exlál|abal|tam jún yab in exlál jawa' xi pél in uchbíl ani an k'e'atnaxtaláb in t'ajámal ka wa'tsin yani kidháb t'anél ani yan jita' axi odhnámej
folded.subject: i exlál
folded.object: tam jún yab in exlál jawa' xi pél in uchbíl ani an k'e'atnaxtaláb in t'ajámal ka wa'tsin yani kidháb t'anél ani yan jita' axi odhnámej

spans.text: Kom i exlál abal tam jún yab in exlál jawa' xi pél in uchbíl ani an k'e'atnaxtaláb in t'ajámal ka wa'tsin yani kidháb t'anél ani yan jita' axi odhnámej, ani kom uluwamej abal i ayál juni ít tsalap junti ka wa'tsin juni k'ay'lál juntij an k'wajílchik yabáts ka xe'tsin k'al i jík'ib mani ka k'wajiy al an ts'ejwantaltaiáb ani ka k'wajiy walkadh abal kin uluw ani kin bela'jawa'its jún kin le'na'.
Kom i exlál abal an éyalchik in tomnál kin beletna' ani kin k'aniy an chubaxtaiáb abal an inikchik yab kin yéjenchij kin dhay'k'a'an k'ak'adh pextaláb abal ka ats'anchat in káwintal.

Kom i exlál abal an bichówlom ti al an "Naciones Unidas" in wichk'ómalchik kin uluw abal in kwa'al in alwa' ichích abal kin k'ak'nanchij in éy ani in jalbíl tin putát an inik ani an uxum, ani in ulúmalchik abal ne'etschik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ka nixk'in an ts'ejwantaláb ti al juni walkadhtalá axi lej púlik tin tomnál ki ejtiy.

Kom i exlál abal an kwenchaláb axi k'wajat junkudh in binámal in káwintal abal neéts kin tolmiy an ONU abal kin k'ak'nanchij jawa' in kwa'al tin uchbíl kin bats'uwchik patal an k'wajíl tejé' al an tsabál, ani
kom i exlál abal axe'chik xi uchbidhtaláb in kwa'al lej yan in jalbíl bala ka putuwat jawa' xi tejé' k'wajat uludh:

folded.id: i k'ij|abal|ka tsink'on
folded.subject: i k'ij
folded.object: ka tsink'on

spans.text: Tam jún xe'ets ti aliyáb abal ka odhnáj, ma jawákits tam bichow in tomnál ka pidhan i k'ij abal ka tsink'on.

folded.id: i k'ij|abal|kin t'ójondha'jún jita' ani yab kin jalbíy
folded.subject: i k'ij
folded.object: kin t'ójondha'jún jita' ani yab kin jalbíy

spans.text: Mani jita' yab pidhach i k'ij abal kin t'ójondha'jún jita' ani yab kin jalbíy, mani in tomnál ka xe'tsindháj ti nujnél jant'ini' t'ajchinalchik an ko'nél.

folded.id: i tsápláb|abal|expidh ka ts'at'ey al juni dhéy t'ojláb max yab in lé'
folded.subject: i tsápláb
folded.object: expidh ka ts'at'ey al juni dhéy t'ojláb max yab in lé'

spans.text: Yab jita in tomnál ka t'ajchin i tsápláb abal expidh ka ts'at'ey al juni dhéy t'ojláb max yab in lé'.

folded.id: in k'ayá'|abal|kin k'anidha' in juntal
folded.subject: in k'ayá'
folded.object: kin k'anidha' in juntal

spans.text: Patal an inik ani an uxum u wa'tsinal walkadh abal jununúl kin bats'uw an alwa'taláb ani ka pidhan in éy jant'ini' in tomnál; in kwa'al in tsalpádh ani in k'ayá' abal kin k'anidha' in juntal.

folded.id: in káwintal|abal|kin ok'xidh walbiy juni jolbinél
folded.subject: in káwintal
folded.object: kin ok'xidh walbiy juni jolbinél

spans.text: An éyal yab in tomnál kin baliy in káwintal abal kin ok'xidh walbiy juni jolbinél.

folded.id: in lé'|abal|an kwenchal ani an bichowchik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ti al an exóbintalab ka k'ák'náj ani ka putuwat tin puwél an bichow axi k'wajat junkudh ti al an "naciones unidas"
folded.subject: in lé'
folded.object: an kwenchal ani an bichowchik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ti al an exóbintalab ka k'ák'náj ani ka putuwat tin puwél an bichow axi k'wajat junkudh ti al an "Naciones Unidas"

spans.text: Axé' xi tsalap tin k'ánél an inikchik tin putát an tsabál, in lé' abal an kwenchal ani an bichowchik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ti al an exóbintalab ka k'ák'náj ani ka putuwat tin puwél an bichow axi k'wajat junkudh ti al an "Naciones Unidas", patal jawa' tejé' jilk'onal uludh.

folded.id: in lé'|abal|ka taley
folded.subject: in lé'
folded.object: ka taley

spans.text: Axé' xi tsalap yab ne'ets ka éyan tam chubax wa'ats juni pulik jolbintaláb ani wa'ats juni k'idháb t'ajnél axi an "Naciones Unidas" in lé' abal ka taley.

folded.id: in tomnál|abal|jilchin i jolát abal ki k'ániy ti bá'
folded.subject: in tomnál
folded.object: jilchin i jolát abal ki k'ániy ti bá'

spans.text: Tam ku jolbiyat k'al juni káw, in tomnál abal jilchin i jolát abal ki k'ániy ti bá'.

folded.id: in ulal|abal|yab in tomnál ka k'e'atnáj tin ébál in tsalápil
folded.subject: in ulal
folded.object: yab in tomnál ka k'e'atnáj tin ébál in tsalápil

spans.text: Patal jolat abal kin tejwamédha' in tsalap ani in káwintal; axé' xi uchbidhtaláb jayetsej in ulal abal yab in tomnál ka k'e'atnáj tin ébál in tsalápil; jayetsej abal kin aliy ani kin bats'uw píl i tsalap ani abal kin buk'uw ma ju'támakits kin le'na' ani k'ai jawákits tam eyixtaláb.

folded.id: in ulúmalchik|abal|ne'etschik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ka nixk'in an ts'ejwantaláb ti al juni walkadhtalá axi lej púlik tin tomnál ki ejtiy
folded.subject: in ulúmalchik
folded.object: ne'etschik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ka nixk'in an ts'ejwantaláb ti al juni walkadhtalá axi lej púlik tin tomnál ki ejtiy

spans.text: Kom i exlál abal an bichówlom ti al an "Naciones Unidas" in wichk'ómalchik kin uluw abal in kwa'al in alwa' ichích abal kin k'ak'nanchij in éy ani in jalbíl tin putát an inik ani an uxum, ani in ulúmalchik abal ne'etschik kin t'aja' an tsápláb abal ka nixk'in an ts'ejwantaláb ti al juni walkadhtalá axi lej púlik tin tomnál ki ejtiy.

folded.id: jayetsej|abal|kin jalk'uy in belkaxtal tam kin le'na'
folded.subject: jayetsej
folded.object: kin jalk'uy in belkaxtal tam kin le'na'

spans.text: Patal k'wajat jolat abal kin kwetém ko'oy in tsalápil ani in belkaxtal, ani abal kin t'aja' ani kin tejwamédha'tin k'imá'ani ju'támits kin le'na', nixé' xi belkaxtaláb, tin kwetémtal ani ti mudhél; jayetsej abal kin jalk'uy in belkaxtal tam kin le'na'.

Patal jolat abal kin tejwamédha' in tsalap ani in káwintal; axé' xi uchbidhtaláb jayetsej in ulal abal yab in tomnál ka k'e'atnáj tin ébál in tsalápil; jayetsej abal kin aliy ani kin bats'uw píl i tsalap ani abal kin buk'uw ma ju'támakits kin le'na' ani k'ai jawákits tam eyixtaláb.

folded.id: ka k'ánchin|abal|kin jalk'uy in kwenchál
folded.subject: ka k'ánchin
folded.object: kin jalk'uy in kwenchál

spans.text: Mani jita' yab in tomnál ka k'ánchin abal kin jalk'uy in kwenchál, max aníts tin lé'.

folded.id: ka tolmiyat|abal|kin bajuw ka ulits al an pulik éyaltaláb tin kwenchál
folded.subject: ka tolmiyat
folded.object: kin bajuw ka ulits al an pulik éyaltaláb tin kwenchál

spans.text: Patal in kwa'ai tin uchbíl ka tolmiyat abal kin bajuw ka ulits al an pulik éyaltaláb tin kwenchál.

folded.id: kin k'ániy|abal|yab ka buk'lun
folded.subject: kin k'ániy
folded.object: yab ka buk'lun

spans.text: An k'imádh jats in tujtal an xe'tsintaláb, jaxtám an éyal in kwa'al tin uchbíl kin k'ak'na', kin beletna' ani kin k'ániy abal yab ka buk'lun.

spans.text: Patal an k'wajíl in uchbíl tin kwa'al abal ka pidhan juni exlomtaláb k'al an éyal ti al an kwenchal juntij k'wjíl.

folded.subject: Yab walkadh
folded.object: jita' ka tsa'uwat

spans.text: Yab walkadh abal jita' ka tsa'uwat, ka ts'ojbédháj mani ka t'ajchin in tidhéj al juni ts'ejeltaiáb.
